channel.title: EngineerzCorneR — Posts
channel.description: Deep-dive technical write-ups across Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Automation, Civil and Solar.

item.title: 4-20mA Current Loops: Why Industry Still Trusts an Analog Signal
item.description: Why 4-20mA beat 0-20mA and voltage signals for instrumentation, what live-zero actually protects against, how to convert a reading back to engineering units.

item.title: Beam Bending Basics: Why Section Modulus Decides Capacity, Not Just Load
item.description: Why a beam's bending capacity comes down to two checks — bending stress against section modulus, and deflection against span — not just the applied load.

item.title: Belt Drive Sizing: Why the Speed Ratio Alone Doesn't Tell You the Tension
item.description: Belt drive speed ratio, belt velocity and shaft torque from pulley diameters and power, and why tension depends on wrap angle and friction, not just geometry.

item.title: Bolt Torque vs Preload: Why K-Factor Is the Number That Actually Matters
item.description: Bolt tightening torque from target preload using the short-form torque-tension relationship, and why the nut factor dominates the result more than bolt grade.

item.title: Cable Glands: What They Do and How to Get the Selection Right
item.description: What a cable gland is actually holding together, the main gland types and their parts, a selection and quality-inspection checklist.

item.title: Cable Schedules Explained: What Goes in One and How It Drives Ordering and Handover
item.description: The fields in a cable schedule, how to choose cable type, a worked example turning a schedule into an order quantity, and what a schedule does not check.

item.title: Cable Size & Current Capacity: A Practical Selection Guide
item.description: Approximate current-carrying capacity for copper and aluminium cables by cross-section, common house-wiring cable sizes by load.

item.title: Cable Tray vs Cable Ladder vs Cable Trunking vs Conduit
item.description: Cable tray, ladder, trunking, and conduit compared — construction, protection level, typical load, where each is used, and how to choose.

item.title: Chilled Water HVAC Systems: How the Loop Actually Works
item.description: How a chilled water HVAC system moves heat from occupied zones all the way out to atmosphere.

item.title: Chiller Capacity and COP: Where the Compressor's Work Actually Goes
item.description: Refrigeration cycle capacity, COP and compressor power, and why condenser heat rejection has to account for the compressor's work input.

item.title: Functional Safety & SIL Explained
item.description: What a Safety Integrity Level really measures: PFDavg and PFH bands, SFF/HFT architectural constraints, voting, and a worked SIF example (IEC 61508/61511).

item.title: From Instrument Index to I/O List: Counting Points and Sizing Cards
item.description: How an instrument index maps to an I/O list, ISA 5.1 tag basics, common I/O patterns by device, why cards are rounded up by type, and what the count leaves out.

item.title: Insulation Resistance Testing Explained
item.description: IEC 60364-6 / BS 7671 test voltages and minimums, motor spot IR and polarization index per IEEE 43, temperature correction and worked examples.

item.title: Load Estimation: The First Step in Electrical Design
item.description: Why load estimation comes before anything else in an electrical project, how to calculate it by floor area, NEC VA/m² guide tables.

item.title: Maximum Demand, Demand Factor and Diversity: Sizing a Supply Below the Connected Load
item.description: Demand factor vs diversity vs coincidence, a worked connected-load to maximum-demand example with current, and why these factors only apply upstream.

item.title: P&ID Instrument Bubbles: Line Types & Tag Anatomy Explained
item.description: What the line under an instrument bubble means — field-mounted, control-room-mounted, or inaccessible — plus how to break down a tag like TT01 using ISA S5.1.

item.title: Pipe Insulation Thickness and Heat Loss: Why Each Layer Helps Less
item.description: The cylindrical heat-loss formula for insulated pipe, a worked 25 vs 50 vs 75 mm example showing diminishing returns, and what the simple formula leaves out.

item.title: Pipe Thermal Expansion: Why a 100m Run Moves More Than You'd Guess
item.description: Linear thermal expansion of a pipe run from material, length and temperature change.

item.title: What a Load Really Costs to Run
item.description: From nameplate kW to the electricity bill: load factor, efficiency, tiered tariffs, demand charges and marginal rate, with a worked motor example.

item.title: Shaft Diameter Sizing: Combining Bending and Torsion with the ASME Equation
item.description: How the ASME shaft equation combines bending and torque with shock and fatigue factors, the allowable shear stress values, a worked 15 kW example and its limits.

item.title: Solar CO2 Offset: How Avoided Emissions Are Estimated, and Why the Factor Matters
item.description: How to estimate CO2 avoided by solar, average vs marginal grid emission factors, lifecycle emissions, degradation, and how reliable tree and car equivalents are.

item.title: Solar Panel Derating: Why Nameplate Wattage Isn't What You Get
item.description: The STC nameplate rating on a solar panel assumes lab conditions no rooftop ever sees.

item.title: Solar Payback Period & ROI: What the Simple Formula Leaves Out
item.description: Why simple payback (cost divided by annual savings) overstates solar economics, and what degradation and rising electricity prices do to the real payback.

item.title: Solar System Sizing: From Daily Load to Panel Count
item.description: How to go from a daily energy load in kWh to an array size in kW, why peak sun hours (not daylight hours) matters, and where the derating factors go.

item.title: Transformer and Generator Sizing: Why Motor Starting Decides the Genset, Not the Running Load
item.description: Transformer kVA from connected load and demand factor, and why standby generator sizing is governed by motor-starting voltage dip rather than the running load.

item.title: Change Order Cost and Schedule Impact
item.description: How to price a change order, why only approved changes move the baseline, and when extra work earns time: critical path and float, with worked examples.

item.title: Earned Value Management: Reading Project Health From Three Numbers
item.description: Why 'on budget' and 'on schedule' need separate proof, what Planned Value, Earned Value and Actual Cost each measure.

item.title: Electrical Panel Factory Acceptance Test (FAT): The Complete Checklist
item.description: The 8 stages of an LV panel FAT — visual/mechanical inspection, insulation resistance, hi-pot, functional, protection and interlock tests, and documentation.

item.title: The Real Cost of Meetings, and How to Make Minutes and Actions Pay Off
item.description: A simple meeting cost formula with a worked weekly example, three ways to cut the cost, and how decisions and action items in good minutes make a meeting worth it.

item.title: The PPP Project Lifecycle: From Identification to Handback
item.description: The eight stages a Public-Private Partnership moves through, from project identification to handback, and the enablers that hold the whole lifecycle together.
